title: [Bug Fix] #638531: Disable Open TO from PO actions on non-subcontracting lines
summary: The Open TO from PO actions on subcontracting purchase order lines are now properly disabled for non-subcontracting lines instead of appearing enabled but doing nothing.
key_points: Transfer Order and Return Transfer Order actions disabled on purchase lines without production order numbers
Action enablement now depends on line-level subcontracting status via OnAfterGetCurrRecord trigger
Prevents confusing UI behavior where actions appear available but execute no operation
Regression test added to verify correct action state for both subcontracting and non-subcontracting lines
